terms.gloss: one who shows the way: satnav
evidence: Verg. G. 1.19: uncīque puer mōnstrātor arātrī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Our use: no reference work has a word for satellite navigation. Classically mōnstrātor is one who shows or points out (poetry and post-Augustan prose); here the device that shows the way.
The international name of the American satellite system, used everywhere as it is.

phrases.latin: Quid dīcit mōnstrātor? — Ad dextram flecte.
phrases.english: What does the satnav say? — Turn right.

sources: The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
